description: Stock on hand right now, per variant per location. Use this for stock levels, stock value and what is out of stock. It is a snapshot with no history, so it cannot answer questions about a past date or a trend.

pv.join: JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.shopify_variant_id = il.shopify_variant_id

p.join: JOIN products p ON p.shopify_product_id = pv.shopify_product_id

loc.join: JOIN inventory_locations loc ON loc.shopify_location_id = il.shopify_location_id

available.description: Units available to sell right now

on_hand.description: Units physically in the warehouse, including committed ones

incoming.description: Units on their way in from suppliers

reserved.description: Units held back and not sellable

stock_value.description: Value of available stock at cost price

variant_count.description: How many different variants are stocked

in_stock_variants.sql: CASE WHEN il.available_quantity > 0 THEN il.shopify_variant_id END
in_stock_variants.description: How many variants have stock available

out_of_stock_variants.sql: CASE WHEN il.available_quantity <= 0 THEN il.shopify_variant_id END
out_of_stock_variants.description: How many variants are out of stock

product.description: The product's own name, which is what people usually mean when they name an item. Anything that looks like a full item name belongs here, not in vendor.

product_type.description: Product category as set in Shopify

vendor.description: The brand or manufacturer on its own, never a full item name. If the text has more words than a brand would, it is a product, not a vendor.

product_status.description: Shopify product status, for example active or archived

variant.description: Full variant name, which contains the colour and the size

size_label.description: Shoe size as written, for example '27.5CM'. Empty for products that have no size. Use this to group by size

size_cm.description: Shoe size in centimetres as a number. Use this to compare sizes, for example smaller than 24

unit_price.description: Catalogue price of one unit, in rupees

stock_status.sql: CASE WHEN il.available_quantity > 0 THEN 'In stock' ELSE 'Out of stock' END
stock_status.description: Either 'In stock' or 'Out of stock' for that variant at that location. Filter on this to find what is out of stock

location.description: Warehouse or store holding the stock
